never_translate.rule: Copied exactly, in every language: the product name, scenario kind names, command and flag names, file names and formats, units and their symbols, numbers, code spans, links and identifiers.

tier_and_verdict_words.rule: Kept in English capitals and never changed, in running text, tables, badges and alt text. The gloss is the translation of what the word means, for use beside the first occurrence on a page.

forbidden_translations.rule: Never state that Kshana is certified, conformant or compliant; the English phrase to use is 'supports evidence for'. These renderings must not be used as claims about Kshana:

en.general: Advisory: analysis output from a research and engineering tool, not type-approved navigation equipment and not a safety-of-life service.
en.general_long: Advisory: analysis output from a research and engineering tool, not type-approved navigation equipment and not a safety-of-life service; it must not be the sole basis for any navigation or safety decision.

advisory.note: Pages use only the four variants above (general, general_long, short, maritime); no aviation variant exists. The 'engine' block lists the English texts of the engine's own advisory constants and fields, keyed by Rust path; entries written '=variant' are identical to that variant.

style.plural_note: one: exactly 1; other: everything else, including 0 and fractions. After a numeral the noun stays in the singular partitive (5 vastaanotinta): write the partitive in both branches of the selector where it differs, and never rely on a plural ending after a number.
style.cases: 15 cases, no articles, no grammatical gender. Use Fluent terms with case attributes (.gen, .part, .ine, .ela, .ill, .ade, .abl, .all, .ess, .tra). Abbreviations and kept-English words take the case ending after a colon (GNSS:n, PNT:n, holdover-tilassa); avoid the problem with a carrier noun where it reads better (GNSS-signaali). The suffix colon is part of the string, not a placeable.
style.register: Neutral technical, impersonal; passive or imperative second person singular on buttons (Käynnistä, Tallenna); no 'te' address. Compound words closed; no hyphen except at a boundary of identical vowels or with abbreviations.
style.separators: Decimal comma; thousands separator a non-breaking space; Intl formats these. Quotation marks ” ” (the same mark both sides). A (non-breaking) space between number and unit, as in the source.
style.fluent: Never hand-write a number into a translated string: use a Fluent placeable (numbers are formatted by Intl at runtime). Choose the plural form with a selector on the CLDR category, and always give the required `*[other]` variant.
